verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the desktop app, the llmster headless daemon and the lms CLI, but none of it documents installing LM Studio or llmster through a standard package manager such as brew, apt, winget, npm or pip. A community comment praises the 'simple install', but that is not package-manager distribution, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
